greeting.speaker: Castellan Ruve
text: The hall is open because there is nothing left in it worth shutting the door on. Say your piece.
Mind the rushes. They were laid for a feast that was cancelled, and nobody has had the heart to sweep them.
Come in, then. The fire is small and the welcome is smaller, but both are honest.

options.text: You've no garrison. Eleven men and a hall built for a hundred.
Whose names are on that wall?
Open the muster rolls to us and we'll hold the pass for you.
Then we'll leave you to it.

again.speaker: Castellan Ruve
text: You are becoming a fixture, and I am short of those. Sit if you like.
I had a letter about you. Badly spelled, and half of it was praise. Make of that what I did.
Back from the pass, and fewer of you than went. I will not ask; I have been asked before.

options.text: You put our name on your wall. Was that a kindness or a debt?
Open the muster rolls to us and we'll hold the pass for you.

who_holds_it.speaker: Castellan Ruve
who_holds_it.text: I do, on paper. The valley holds it in practice, and the valley is being emptied a farm at a time.

counted.speaker: Castellan Ruve
counted.text: Nine, and two of them green. You count well. Don't say the number out loud past that door.

sworn_in.speaker: Castellan Ruve
sworn_in.text: Then the hall is yours to muster from. Bring back the pass, and I'll put your name on the wall with the ones who held it before you.

rebuffed.speaker: Castellan Ruve
rebuffed.text: The keep has heard enough from strangers this season. Walk the yard, touch nothing, and go.

the_wall.speaker: Castellan Ruve
the_wall.text: Men who held the pass. The last four are cut smaller than the rest, because by then we were saving stone. I would rather not save any more.

how_it_stands.speaker: Castellan Ruve
text: Standing. That is the whole of the report and it took me a fortnight to be able to give it.
Two more gone over the wall at night. I have stopped having them fetched back.
Better, since the road began to carry your name instead of theirs.

the_debt.speaker: Castellan Ruve
the_debt.text: Both. That is what a wall of names is. Every one of them was a kindness at the time and a debt by the spring.
